# Ezekiel 5 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 5:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | A-third in-the-fire you-shall-burn in-the-midst-of the-city when-are-fulfilled the-days-of the-siege; and-you-shall-take the-third, you-shall-strike with-the-sword all-around-it; and-the-third you-shall-scatter to-the-wind, and-a-sword I-will-draw-out after-them. |
| LOGOS | A third part you shall burn in the fire in the midst of the city, when the days of the siege are completed. And a third part you shall take and strike with the sword all around the city. And a third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will unsheathe the sword after them. |
| PNEUMA | When the siege in your model ends, burn a third of the hair inside the city you drew. Take another third and chop it with the sword all around the city. Scatter the last third to the wind — and I will chase them with a drawn sword. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 5:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-you-shall-take from-there a-few in-number, and-bind-them in-your-skirts. |
| LOGOS | And you shall take from these a small number and bind them in the skirts of your robe. |
| PNEUMA | But save a few strands and tuck them into your robe. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 5:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-she-rebelled against-My-judgments in-wickedness more-than the-nations, and-against-My-statutes more-than the-countries which [are] all-around-her; for My-judgments they-rejected, and-My-statutes — they-did-not-walk in-them." |
| LOGOS | And she has rebelled against My rules by doing wickedness more than the nations, and against My statutes more than the countries all around her; for they have rejected My rules and have not walked in My statutes." |
| PNEUMA | But she rebelled against My commands and laws more wickedly than any of the nations around her. She rejected My rules and refused to follow My ways." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 5:10 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Therefore fathers shall-eat sons in-your-midst, and-sons shall-eat their-fathers; and-I-will-execute judgments against-you, and-I-will-scatter all your-remnant to-every wind. |
| LOGOS | Therefore fathers shall eat their sons in your midst, and sons shall eat their fathers. And I will execute judgments on you, and any of you who survive I will scatter to all the winds. |
| PNEUMA | Parents will eat their own children in your streets, and children will eat their parents. I will punish you and scatter your survivors to the four winds. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 5:16 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | When-I-send against-them the-evil arrows-of famine which shall-be for-destruction, which I-will-send to-destroy-you, and-famine I-will-increase upon-you, and-I-will-break for-you [the]-staff-of bread. |
| LOGOS | when I send against you the deadly arrows of famine, arrows for destruction, which I will send to destroy you, and when I bring more and more famine upon you and break your supply of bread. |
| PNEUMA | I will shoot My deadly arrows of famine at you — arrows meant to destroy. I will pile famine on top of famine and cut off your food supply completely. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 5:11 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "And-I-will-diminish-you, and-My-eye shall-not-spare, and-I also will-have-no-pity, for-all your-abominations," declares the-Lord YHWH. |
| LOGOS | I will withdraw from you and show no pity, and I will have no compassion because of all your detestable practices, declares the Lord GOD. |
| PNEUMA | I will cut you down without pity or compassion because of all your disgusting sins, declares the Lord GOD. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
